prose: Latent Space's Nov. 6 AINews, 'Anthropic IPO: Whither Now?', calls it a quiet news day while the AI market rout deepened but may be leveling off at about -10% on the Nasdaq. With everything priced to perfection, valuation estimates for Anthropic have dropped as low as $1T and IPO probability fell 18%. It notes Anthropic's year-end target of a $100B run rate, now at $80B, and links a bonus weekend podcast with Jamin Ball on the IPO. It also mentions ARC Prize testing Inkling 2 Small and Thinking Machines explaining how it caught early checkpoints bypassing guardrails.
highlights: Nasdaq about -10%, not yet a bear market
Anthropic valuation estimates as low as $1T; IPO odds down 18%
Anthropic run rate $80B vs a $100B year-end target
